card/bazar.subject: a covered bazaar: a merchant seated in one arched shop opening of a plain vaulted brick arcade, its shelves stocked with glass vessels, blank paper rolls and folded bolts of plain striped cloth, takes gold coins from a standing buyer; the arcade has plain brick arches and no inscription band, sign or frieze
card/bazar.promptAmend: Paint every folded bolt and stacked roll in solid colour with only plain straight stripes along its length; no strokes, squiggles, flecks or marks inside any band or on any bolt face. Leave the vault above the shop opening as plain brick.
reasons: Passes the gate (band 100%, dE00 1.6).

No text at native size or 2x: the counter and shelf bolts carry plain straight stripes, the paper rolls are blank, the red hanging cloth has plain pinstripes, the arch is a plain brick vault with no frieze, band or sign; a striped bolster's narrow bands carry kilim-like repeated hooks and dots, ornament rather than script even at 3x to 4x.
Reads at 120 px as a covered shop: a merchant in a brick-arched opening with shelves of blue and green glass and stacked cloth takes coins from a standing buyer.

Batch check: Bazar (an enclosed arched shop with shelves), Marketplace (two traders kneeling on an open mat) and the reused Forum (an outdoor stall under an awning) read as three different places at 120 px.

Two figures, no background kiosk, a clear ivory margin; style matches the Duel neighbours, with slightly more naturalistic bricks. Reviewer: a fresh in-process subagent that did not write the prompts and had not seen round 1.

card/castrum.subject: a compact army camp seen from slightly above: a square earthen rampart topped by a low timber fence, a plain timber gate guarded by two sentries with spears, and inside the rampart neat rows of plain white tents; no banners, no flags, no emblems
reasons: Passes the gate (band 100%, dE00 4.5).
No text, banners, flags or emblems: the large tent's valance is a repeated scallop with white dots, the paper the commander holds is blank, the finials plain knobs.
Reads clearly at 120 px as an army camp seen from above: a square earthen rampart with a low timber fence, a timber gate between two spear-carrying sentries, rows of white tents.
Batch check: the only aerial view among the red cards, copying none of them (Barracks sparring before a wall, Stockade raising stakes, Walls masonry).

Small figures, as the subject requires; the rampart spans wide but the gate passes; palette and ink line match the Duel red neighbours. Reviewer: a fresh in-process subagent that did not write the prompts.

card/clay-pit.subject: two workers in one shallow open pit: one carries a basket of wet ochre clay up the bank, the other prises lumps of rust-red iron ore, glinting with dark metallic flecks, from a seam exposed in the pit wall; the clay and the ore both clearly visible as two different materials
reasons: Passes the gate (band 100%, dE00 3.3); no text: the dome's gold pattern is floral sprigs, the parapet and pit walls are plain.
Two large figures read at 120 px: the clay carrier climbing the bank with a basket on his shoulder, and the miner at the seam.

Clay and ore are distinct at shipped size without counting: ochre clay heaps and a full basket on the left, a dark crimson ore seam with blue-grey metallic flecks and fallen lumps on the right (the clay looks dry rather than wet, a minor point).
Clearly a different painting from Duel's clay-pit (a shallow open pit with an ore seam, against Duel's deep shaft with a rope-hauled basket).

Brown accent fits; style, density and figure scale match the anchor and Duel's clay-pool and brickyard; one domed pavilion, no minaret, emblem or animals. Reviewer: a fresh in-process subagent that did not write the prompts.

card/excavation.subject: two diggers in one stepped excavation cut into a low hillside: on the upper ledge one levers out a squared block of pale limestone, on the floor below the other shovels soft ochre clay into a basket; the pale stone above and the ochre clay below both clearly visible as two different materials
card/excavation.promptAmend: Leave out the background pavilion entirely: behind the excavation show only cypresses, a flowering shrub and pastel rocky hills, with no building, parapet, frieze or corner ornament anywhere in the picture.
reasons: Passes the gate (band 100%, dE00 3.9), with wide paper margins: the painting spans about 73% of the crop width.
No text, glyphs or emblems at native size or 2x: the robes carry loose gold floral sprigs, the sash plain stripes, the stone faces only cracks, and there is no building.
Stone and clay are distinct and balanced at 120 px: stacked pale limestone blocks on the upper ledge, a bright ochre pit with a filled basket below, split diagonally with equal weight.
Two large figures, uncluttered; line, palette and density match Duel's quarry neighbours.
The orange pit separates it from Duel's all-pale shelf-quarry and quarry, and the white ledge from clay-pit and tree-farm. Reviewer: a fresh in-process subagent that did not write the prompts.

card/forest-cave.subject: at the round dark mouth of a small cave in a wooded hillside, a woodcutter carries a bundle of cut logs on his shoulder while a second worker steps out of the cave with a basket heaped with lumps of rust-red iron ore, glinting with dark metallic flecks; two or three tall broadleaf trees frame the cave; the logs and the ore both clearly visible as two different materials
card/forest-cave.promptAmend: Put the two materials on the open ground in front of the cave, each about as large as a standing figure: on the left a neat stack of cut brown logs showing pale ring ends, on the right a heap of rust-red ore lumps with dark metallic glints spilling from the cave mouth onto pale ochre ground. Keep the cave mouth smaller and the foliage sparser, so the log stack and the ore heap are the boldest shapes at a glance.
reasons: Passes the gate (band 96.0%, dE00 3.7); the right-hand rocks come within about 10 px of the crop edge but fade out, as wide as the approved mine #1.
No text, emblem or mark at native size and 2x: plain tunics and belts, a natural rock arch, an empty dark interior.
Wood and ore both read and balance at 120 px: a large stack of sawn brown logs plus a carried bundle, and a rust-red ore heap with dark and silver glints, each larger than a figure.

Against mine #1, which shares a dark opening with an ore heap at lower right: the other material differs (brown log cylinders against white cubes), the carried load repeats it, the opening differs (natural arch against a squared door) and so do the trees (broadleaf against cypress), so a player would not confuse them at 120 px.
Line, palette and density match Duel's logging-camp and the pilot's ore-vein. Reviewer: a fresh in-process subagent that did not write the prompts.

card/foundry.subject: two metalworkers at a squat round smelting furnace glowing at its mouth: one tips a basket of rust-red iron ore, glinting with dark metallic flecks into the furnace, the other pours a glowing orange melt from a crucible into a row of plain ingot moulds; two large heaps of the same rust-red ore lie beside the furnace, and a few finished dark iron ingots, plain and unmarked, rest beside the moulds; one material only, no weapons, no blades, no armour
card/foundry.promptAmend: Leave out the background pavilion entirely: behind the furnace show only a few trees and pastel rocky hills, with no building anywhere. Pattern every robe with loose, irregular leafy sprigs or small round rosettes, never a uniform repeated lily, trefoil or cross shape; the lapis robe may also be left plain. Paint the ingot moulds and the ingots flat, with ink outlines and no glossy highlights.
reasons: Passes the gate (band 93.7%, dE00 5.2); the widest scene in the family (the left ore heap's outer lumps come within about 3 to 9 px of the left edge at 480 px, the ingots end about 19 px from the right), as wide as the approved forest-cave #2 and timber-yard #2, and a simulated in-app soft feather keeps both heaps and all ingots legible.

No building, text, glyph band, signature, weapon or blade at native size or 2x; both robes carry loose leafy sprigs (cream on vermilion, gold on lapis), with no lily, trefoil, cross or other repeated emblem even at 4x (checked again at 2x by the integrator); sashes, moulds, ingots and crucible are plain.

One material in quantity, as the card produces two ore: two large rust-red heaps with dark and silver glints, a basket tipping more into the furnace, and ore glowing in its mouth; the dark moulds and ingots read as cast metal, not as a second material.
The ingots and moulds are matte and ink-outlined like Duel brickyard's bricks; two large figures, uncluttered.
Distinct in the family: the only furnace, fire and ingots. Reviewer: a fresh in-process subagent that did not write the prompts and had not seen earlier rounds.

card/loom.promptAmend: Keep the background pavilion plain: its parapet, door panels and steps show only simple geometric tile bands with no lettering, glyphs or script-like marks. reasons: Passes the gate (band 100%, dE00 4.9); the 4:3 crop keeps every element with about 100 px of ivory paper at left and right; the edges feather cleanly; no signature or watermark in the corners.

No text or pseudo-writing at full resolution: the robe has rosettes and gold specks only, no fleurs-de-lis; the bolt and the cloth on the loom are plain rose and lapis stripes with gold pinstripes and nothing inside the stripes; the kiosk's parapet band is diamonds, rosettes and palmettes with no strokes or baseline, tile ornament (checked again at 6x by the integrator).
Reads at 120 px as one large weaver at an upright loom with striped cloth, and a striped bolt on a stool; no crowd.

Grey accent carried by the slate robe and veil, matching Duel's grey cards; line, opaque gouache, lilac rocks and density match the anchor; gold on finials, pinstripes, sash and specks (the gold kiosk dome is a minor excess, small and in the background).

One small domed garden kiosk, no minaret, mosque, emblem or animals; generic period dress. The cloth reads as woven cloth on a loom (white warp above the woven edge, boat shuttle in hand), not a carpet, rug or banner. Reviewer: a fresh in-process subagent that did not write the prompts.

card/ludus.subject: a training school run as a business: in a plain sandy courtyard a trainer in a simple tunic, a wooden practice sword under his arm, receives a pouch of gold coins from a merchant, beside a wooden practice post scarred by sword strokes and a rack of wooden practice swords; no soldiers, no uniforms, no spears, no armour, no banners
reasons: Passes the gate (band 100%, dE00 2.6).

No text at native size or 2x: the pavilion's eave and base are geometric and floral tiles, the practice post carries random hack scars, and the robes carry small irregular leafy sprigs with dots, not fleurs-de-lis (checked again at 3x by the integrator). A gold-domed pavilion the subject does not name stands at left, against the card template, but it carries no marks and the training gear still dominates, so it is not a rejection.

Reads at 120 px as a training yard, not two men talking: a tall scarred practice post with a rope collar, a rack of wooden practice swords, and a man with a wooden sword taking a coin pouch from a merchant.
Batch check: no soldiers, red uniforms, spears, armour or banners, so it does not read as the reused Training Ground, Barracks or another red card; distinct from the yellow Arena's tiered seating.
Two large figures, clean margins; style matches the Duel neighbours. Reviewer: a fresh in-process subagent that did not write the prompts.

card/marketplace.subject: an open-air market square with no awning, canopy or stall: two traders, one arriving from the left and one from the right, meet over a plain mat spread on the paving and trade manufactured goods, the left one setting down a pair of green glass flasks, the right one a blank papyrus roll and a folded bolt of plain striped cloth, with a small heap of gold coins on the mat between them

No text at native size or 2x: plain blue and cream stripes on the bolt, a blank papyrus roll, plain coins. A small domed kiosk the subject does not name sits at top right, against the card template, but its parapet panels are symmetric rosette sprigs and its eave a uniform beaded strip with no pseudo-writing at 2x or 3x, and it does not hurt the read, so it is not a rejection.
Reads at 120 px as open-air trade: two traders kneeling on a plain mat exchange green flasks, a roll and a striped bolt over a heap of coins, with no awning, canopy or stall.

card/mine.subject: two miners at a squared mine entrance cut into a grey rock hill, its lintel one slab of stone: one carries a squared block of pale stone out on his shoulder, the other tips a basket of rust-red iron ore, glinting with dark metallic flecks onto a heap; a stack of pale stone blocks and a heap of rust-red ore lie apart in front of the entrance, clearly two different materials

card/vineyard.subject: a vintner beneath a low wooden vine trellis heavy with dark grape bunches hands a full basket of grapes to a woodcutter, who carries a bundle of logs on his back and pays him with a few gold coins; rows of vines behind them, no cups or drinking
